title: High-Protein Cottage Cheese, Avocado & Egg Whites on Sourdough Toast
originalTitle: Cottage cheese, avocado, egg whites on toast
ingredients: 2 slices thick-cut sourdough bread, toasted golden
1/2 medium Hass avocado, sliced or lightly mashed with lemon juice
3/4 cup liquid egg whites (about 4 egg whites), softly scrambled or fried into a patty
1 tsp Everything Bagel seasoning & pinch of red pepper flakes
Flaky sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Toast the sourdough slices until crisp and golden brown.
In a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat, cook the egg whites with a pinch of salt and black pepper until softly set.
Spread the cottage cheese generously across the warm sourdough toast, layer with sliced avocado and warm egg whites, and finish with Everything Bagel seasoning and chili flakes.
